newsitem.title: GERMANY: German town blackmailed over 'wasted' taxes.
newsitem.headline: German town blackmailed over 'wasted' taxes.

text.p: A blackmailer has demanded 5.12 million marks ($2.9 million) from a German town that he has accused of wasting taxpayers' money, police said on Wednesday.

The unidentified man made his demands in a letter addressed to police in the city of Wiesbaden last week, warning that town councillors in the nearby town of Ruedesheim would be harmed if they did not heed him.

Police said the blackmailer complained of "systematic squandering of taxpayers' money" in Ruedesheim. Police had not heard from him since but said cash had been set aside in case his threat was serious.
Members of Ruedesheim's council as well as local public employees were taking extra security precautions.
It was not immediately clear why the blackmailer had demanded the precise figure of 5.12 million marks.

Germany has some of the highest taxes in the world and the government is trying to push through a reform to lower the burden on citizens and businesses. Despite that, many local authorities are close to bankruptcy. ($ = 1.759 German Marks)
